inputs.text: It's heartbreaking how this Iran war keeps grinding on, with energy prices spiking and hitting working families and the poorest communities hardest, flights grounded, and endless scenes of death and destruction dominating our screens. Bloomberg points out that people everywhere are demanding an end to what they see as a poorly planned, unwinnable conflict that's a clear peril to global well-being. Yet the public in Israel remains strongly behind pushing it forward without a clear end in sight. This stark divide exposes how militaristic policies rooted in historical power imbalances and institutional biases continue to sacrifice vulnerable populations worldwide while shielding those in positions of relative privilege from the full human and economic costs.
